title: Pocketwire Rewards Loyalty Terms: Courtesy Loyalty Supplement
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members with at least one whole year of membership and sustained card spend receive a loyalty supplement on a courtesy credit for late fulfilment.

## Clause

The courtesy loyalty supplement is 1500 points when the membership has completed at least 3 whole years and the courtesy loyalty spend is at least 40000 USD; it is 500 points when the member does not meet that first condition but the membership has completed at least 1 whole year and the courtesy loyalty spend is at least 15000 USD; and it is nothing otherwise. The supplement is added to the courtesy credit for the late redemption, in whole points.

## Definitions

- The courtesy loyalty spend is the spend carried by earning entries dated within the last twelve months less the spend carried by clawback entries dated within the same twelve months.
- Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries.
- A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.
- The membership's whole years are the whole months from the enrolment date to the handling date divided by twelve and rounded down.

## Supplement by years and spend

| Whole years of membership | Courtesy loyalty spend | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | 40000 USD or more | 1500 points |
| 3 or more | 15000 USD or more, below 40000 USD | 500 points |
| 1 or 2 | 15000 USD or more | 500 points |
| 1 or more | below 15000 USD | nothing |
| 0 | any | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- 2 whole years and 60000 USD of loyalty spend: the first condition fails on years; 500 points.
- 4 whole years with earning entries of 41000 USD and clawback entries of 2000 USD: the loyalty spend is 39000 USD, below 40000 USD; 500 points.
